# Source

Cloned from https://github.com/sakshimohan/uganda_hbp (public, Sakshi Mohan's
Uganda HBP repository accompanying Mohan et al. 2023, Health Policy and
Planning). Only `2_data/hbp_data_clean_v2.xlsx`, `2_data/new_intervention_names.xlsx`,
`4_outputs/` (her own published result tables/figures), and `README.md` are
kept here - the large raw workbooks and her own R scripts are not duplicated
(her scripts are referenced/ported in this project's R/18_mohan_optimization.R
and main_optimization_uganda_validation.R instead).

Used to externally validate this project's find_optimal_package() port: see
main_optimization_uganda_validation.R, which reproduces her published Table 2
"Base scenario" results (data/external/uganda_hbp/4_outputs/tables/table_2_result_summary.csv).
